verdict.rationale: Independent production users describe Better Auth as open source ('better-auth (open source)', 'the best open-source option'), and it ships as an npm package with releases published from GitHub. However, no first-party evidence names the license or links to a source repository. missing for 10: first-party statement of the specific open license (e.g. MIT), documented public source repository link, vendor confirmation that all features (including enterprise ones) are under that license

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: We have been using better-auth (open source) for a while
IMO it's the best open-source option for a TypeScript developer who wants to implement authentication.
Every release shipped to Better Auth, straight from GitHub.
